# SHA256 of the tools CI downloads, pinned here on purpose.
#
# Recording them here rather than fetching them is the point. A checksum
# published beside the artifact proves nothing, because whoever could replace
# the binary could replace that file with it. These live in the repo, so if a
# published artifact ever changes, CI fails instead of running it.
#
# Linux amd64 artifacts, not the Mac repo's darwin/arm64 ones -- this CI runs
# on ubuntu-latest.
#
# actionlint is the only one of the four that publishes a checksums file of
# its own. Its published hash for actionlint_1.7.12_linux_amd64.tar.gz was
# confirmed against the line below when this file was written, which is
# worth doing once at the moment of pinning even though it cannot be trusted
# as an ongoing check. shellcheck, shfmt and taplo publish nothing to compare
# against: no .sha256 file and no sha256sums.txt beside any of their
# releases.
#
# The four filenames are not spelled the same way, and that is upstream's
# choice, not a mistake here: shellcheck writes the platform as
# linux.x86_64, with dots; shfmt writes linux_amd64, with underscores, and
# ships a bare binary rather than an archive; actionlint also writes
# linux_amd64 but inside a tarball; taplo writes linux-x86_64, with hyphens,
# and gzips a bare binary. The workflow's verify() looks a hash up by exact
# filename and refuses to install a file it has no line for, so record the
# name precisely as the workflow fetches it -- a mistranscribed name fails
# loudly, as "no checksum recorded", rather than silently checking the wrong
# line.
#
# To update after bumping a version in ci.yml, run bump-tools.sh -- it moves
# the pin and refreshes the hash below in the same pass, so the two cannot
# drift apart.
8aca8db96f1b94770f1b0d72b6dddcb1ebb8123cb3712530b08cc387b349a3d8  actionlint_1.7.12_linux_amd64.tar.gz
8c3be12b05d5c177a04c29e3c78ce89ac86f1595681cab149b65b97c4e227198  shellcheck-v0.11.0.linux.x86_64.tar.xz
fb096c5d1ac6beabbdbaa2874d025badb03ee07929f0c9ff67563ce8c75398b1  shfmt_v3.13.1_linux_amd64
8fe196b894ccf9072f98d4e1013a180306e17d244830b03986ee5e8eabeb6156  taplo-linux-x86_64.gz
